faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Dubai Internet City Free Zone.

items.q: What is Dubai Internet City and who is it for?
items.a: Dubai Internet City (DIC) is the Middle East's largest ICT free zone, home to 3,500+ tech companies including Google, Microsoft, Oracle, and IBM. It's ideal for software, IT services, digital marketing, e-commerce, and tech startups.

items.q: What licenses are available in DIC?
items.a: Software Development, IT Services, Digital Marketing, Data & Cloud Services, E-Commerce, and Professional/Consulting licenses.

items.q: How long does it take to set up a company in DIC?
items.a: Typically 3-5 working days with proper documentation. Our team ensures a fast and smooth process.

items.q: Can I get 100% foreign ownership in DIC?
items.a: Yes. DIC allows 100% foreign ownership — no local sponsor required.

items.q: What are the tax benefits of DIC?
items.a: 0% corporate and personal income tax with full repatriation of profits and capital — one of the UAE's most favorable tax regimes.

items.q: Can I open a corporate bank account with a DIC license?
items.a: Yes. We help open corporate bank accounts with top UAE banks based on your business profile.

items.q: What office spaces are available in DIC?
items.a: Flexi-desks, coworking spaces, executive offices, and premium fitted offices. Data centers and server hosting are also available.

items.q: Is DIC suitable for startups and freelancers?
items.a: Yes. DIC offers cost-effective flexi-desks and virtual office options perfect for startups, freelancers, and remote-first tech teams.

items.q: What support does Setup Zone Dubai provide?
items.a: We handle company registration, trade name approval, license issuance, visas, bank account opening, compliance, and digital launch services.

items.q: Can I sponsor my family with a DIC license?
items.a: Yes. DIC supports family visa sponsorship for dependents, along with investor and employment visas.
